title: Spyglass: Unleashed and Ready!
summary: Get ready to experience unparalleled clarity and insights with the official launch of Spyglass, now out of beta and packed with powerful features to empower your success.

title: Enhanced File Management and Display Options
summary: Take complete control of your content with new, intuitive tools to effortlessly upload, manage, and customize the visual presentation of all your images and files directly within the editor.

title: Launch of Our Official Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our dynamic new public roadmap to gain transparent insights into recent accomplishments, upcoming features, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a more intuitive and visually cohesive task management experience with our redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and effortlessly draggable.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience a more fluid and intuitive collaboration flow within the editor, making teamwork effortless and keeping everyone perfectly aligned.

title: Seamless Collaboration and Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on shared ideas and quests with your network, making teamwork more intuitive and powerful.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering users with greater control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the project's evolution.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Noeko is expanding its horizons by introducing support for a wide array of international languages, making it more accessible to users globally.

title: New and Improved Themes
summary: We are enhancing our current themes and introducing a vibrant collection of new ones to give your workspace a fresh, personalized look.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Unlock new levels of insight and productivity with our enhanced knowledge map, featuring advanced filtering by tags and time, alongside a clearer view of your shared items and collaborations.

title: Precision Search & Curated Knowledge Collections
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge with powerful new search filters, allowing you to create and save custom collections for immediate access to specific insights.

title: Dynamic Content Display Modes
summary: Elevate your note-taking experience with dynamic new display modes for linked content, offering greater flexibility and interactivity to better organize your thoughts.

title: Noeko: Empowering Your Control with Self-Hosting and Premium Features
summary: Gain ultimate flexibility and control over your Noeko environment with upcoming self-hosting options and unlock advanced capabilities tailored to enhance your productivity.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Enjoy a perfectly timed welcome on your homepage as we refine our greetings to match your current time of day, enhancing your personalized experience.

title: Enhanced Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly organize your content by quickly unapplying tags from multiple items directly within your tag view, streamlining your workflow.

title: Unlock Diverse Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate and interact with a wider variety of content, including videos, websites, and text, directly within your workspace.
